info.title: OpenAsy Forms
info.description: Lead, contact and NPS forms set in forms.yaml: the public API pages and the embed script call, the answers for members, and the erasure contract Audience calls. Viewers read everything; editors mark spam, send again and delete answers; admins take erasures.

get.summary: A form, as a page draws it
get.description: From the form's own page, from a page on one of the form's embed origins (CORS), or from a server (no Origin). Comes with a fresh token. The language is lang, else the browser's, among those the form is written in.

post.description: Checked as the form's pages and show_if say. The same token sends one answer: sending it again answers 200 with the same id. An answer the spam filters take for a bot's is answered the same way and kept as spam.

post.summary: Say how far a page got
post.description: Kept as the form's partials setting says: nothing (off), the pages reached and fields answered (progress), or the answers so far (answers).

post.summary: Attach a file to a file field
post.description: The body is the file; x-file-name its name, URI-encoded. Its bytes must be one of the field's types. Send its id as the field's answer.

post.summary: An answer was sent, to a webhook in the file
post.description: Signed as Standard Webhooks (standardwebhooks.com) signs: webhook-signature is v1,<base64 HMAC-SHA256 of "<webhook-id>.<webhook-timestamp>.<body>">, keyed with the secret the file names (a whsec_<base64> secret is used as those bytes). Reject a timestamp more than 5 minutes off. Answer 2xx; anything else is tried again after 1, 2, 4 minutes and so on, for three days, and a 4xx but 408 and 429 is not tried again.

honeypot.description: The name of the field people never see; send it empty.

proofOfWork.description: Zero bits sha256(token:proof) must start with; null for none.

yaml.description: The form as it is written in its file.

answers.description: null for a partial that keeps only how far it got.
